The amount of video memory that is free, in bytes. Every image and texture uses some of it.
@returns The free video memory in bytes.
@gap The graphics card cannot be asked how much of its memory is still free. This returns the same number as [TotalVidMem](TotalVidMem), and 0 when no graphics window is open.
